facts.fact: The Sudanese Cybersecurity Authority's page describes SUDAPASS as the national digital identity platform providing secure identity verification with multi-factor authentication (biometrics, PIN code, QR code).

SDN.note: No civil register link is stated.
No enrolment or coverage figure is given.
Operation, maintenance and ownership are not stated beyond the Authority's lead.
No public register keyed on the ID is named.
The page describes an authentication platform, not a national ID register or issuance.
